page.overview:
Who is Shinobu Kocho?

Shinobu Kocho is the Insect Hashira, a petite Demon Slayer who uses speed and wisteria poison in place of decapitating strength.

Also known as: Shinobu, Insect Hashira, Shinobu Kochou.
